snippet.title: The Phantom - Gameplay Showcase
snippet.description:
THE PHANTOM GAMEPLAY SHOWCASE
Level 1 - Trouble In The Deep Woods

- Coming to all consoles March 12
- Demo available on STEAM Feb 24th - https://store.steampowered.com/app/2444160/The_Phantom/
- Pre-order digital at the Art Of Play Shop for exclusive digital goodies and limited artist prints - https://artofplayshop.com/
- Pre-order a physical copy The Phantom through Limited Run - https://limitedrungames.com/collections/all-games/products/the-phantom-standard-edition-switch-ps5
#thephantom #steamnextfest #beatemup
